doc.title: Neal Caine interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019

title: Bassists who want to be saxophonists
summary: Rowe and Caine agree some bassists show off; the bass job is like the offensive line.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Yeah I have to say that I’ve played with a few bass players who I feel like telling them I think you’re playing the wrong instrument. You really want to be a saxophone player.
Yeah or a guitar player or whatever. Right.
There’s a certain amount of, not humility, of just taking pleasure and pride in what you said, swinging the band.
Yeah. Kind of like the offensive line in football you know. Like kind of do the job.
